column1: Queen loss fails to elicit physiological and transcriptional responses in workers of the invasive garden ant Lasius neglectus

Holman: 3 sheets containing the list of pheen pheromone responsive genes from Holman 2019, the blast results for these genes in Lasius neglectus, and the Deseq2 results for the genes expressed in the fat bodies

TIJ: We extracted all Orthogroups containing proteins (387) associated with 123 TIJ-Life genes (published in Korb et al 2021). From these matched orthogroups, we extracted the elements which contain the DEGs associated with a) inside workers b) outside workers c) young queens d) old queens

We repeated a similar process for 85 proteins associated with oxidative stress (Kramer et al 2021); There were no queen DEGs that matched against the orthogroup list of oxidative stress genes from D. melanogaster
The last sheet contains the 4 vitellogenins detected by conducting Reciprocal BLASTp of our proteome against those sequences classified as vitellogenins in Kohlmeier et al 2018
